summary_bullets: Install larch via sparse marketplace checkout that omits larch-logs and mermaid-lint, eliminating run-log bulk and install-time npm
Refresh the marketplace in place on steady-state upgrades instead of remove-and-reclone
Relocate the Mermaid dev toolchain to mermaid-lint/ and repoint CI, Makefile, and docs
Remove /upgrade-larch offline harnesses intentionally; no replacement tests added
commit_message:
Speed up /upgrade-larch with sparse checkout and in-place marketplace refresh

Exclude larch-logs/ and mermaid-lint/ from the plugin sparse cone so installs skip committed run logs and never run npm install. Use marketplace update on the steady-state path with a one-time sparse re-add for legacy full clones. Move package.json into mermaid-lint/ and repoint Mermaid lint paths in CI and docs. Delete the upgrade-larch offline harnesses per plan.
